description: List the current scene: every object with type, transform, dimensions, visibility, selection and collections, plus active object, camera, mode and render engine.
name: scene_graph

description: Detailed state of one object: transform, world bounding box, modifiers, materials, mesh counts or light/camera settings.
name: object_info

description: Look at the scene. Returns a PNG image. In background sessions this renders from the scene camera (a temporary camera framing all visible objects is used when none exists); in GUI sessions it captures the 3D viewport.

source.description: auto = viewport in GUI sessions, render in background sessions.

name: screenshot

description: Search Blender's operators (bpy.ops) by keywords, e.g. 'add cube' or 'bevel'. Use before call_operator when you do not know the exact idname.
name: search_operators

description: Show an operator's parameters with types and enum values.
name: describe_operator

description: Run a Blender operator (bpy.ops.<idname>) with keyword parameters, inside a context override for the given editor area (default VIEW_3D).

area_type.description: Editor area to run in, e.g. VIEW_3D, NODE_EDITOR.

name: call_operator

description: Read an RNA property of a datablock, e.g. collection='objects', name='Cube', path='location' or path="modifiers['Bevel'].width".

collection.description: bpy.data collection: objects, meshes, materials, scenes, ...

path.description: RNA data path relative to the datablock.

name: get_property

description: Assign an RNA property of a datablock. Vectors are JSON arrays.

collection.description: bpy.data collection: objects, meshes, materials, scenes, ...

path.description: RNA data path relative to the datablock.

value.description: New value (number, string, boolean or array).

name: set_property

description: Snapshot the whole file so it can be restored later. Returns a checkpoint id.
name: checkpoint

description: Restore the file to a checkpoint taken earlier in this session.
name: restore

description: Save the current file as a .blend at the given path.
name: save

description: Run Python inside Blender with `bpy` imported. Printed output is returned; assign to `result` to return a value. Only available when the session allows it.
name: exec_python
